title: HB0786 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 14, Part 1; Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 40, Chapter 35, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Chaptered, 2021-04-09; same official document as TN-SB-765-2021.chaptered.txt (https://publications.tnsosfiles.com/acts/112/pub/pc0108.pdf); 2021-04-09)
provenance.note: Chaptered, Public Chapter 108 (approved 2021-04-09); House and Senate twins share this text. Text is quoted in part. Section 2 rewrites 39-17-1313(a) to let non-permit lawful carriers keep guns and ammunition in vehicles; Sections 3-5 swap 'permit holder' wording; Section 7 sets the permit-in-possession rule for concealed permits; Sections 8-9 make firearm theft a higher grade; Section 12 sets 85% service for listed firearm-possession offenses; Section 13 makes carrying with intent to go armed a Class B misdemeanor for people with stalking or repeat-DUI convictions, mental-health adjudications, or federal prohibitions. Effective July 1, 2021.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): (g) It is an exception to the application of subsection (a) that a person is carrying, whether openly or concealed, a handgun and:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): (2) The person lawfully possesses the handgun; and
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): (3) The person is in a place where the person is lawfully present.
SECTION 6 (TCA 39-17-1351(n)(1)): The permit holder shall have the permit in the holder's immediate possession at all times when carrying a handgun in a location or manner that would be prohibited if not for the person's status as an enhanced handgun carry permit holder and shall display the permit on demand of a law enforcement officer under such circumstances.
SECTION 10 (TCA 39-14-105(d)): (d) Theft of a firearm shall be punished by confinement for not less than one hundred eighty (180) days in addition to any other penalty authorized by law.
SECTION 11 (TCA 40-35-114): (29) The offense involved the theft of a firearm from a motor vehicle, as defined in § 55-1-103;
SECTION 13 (new subsection of TCA 39-17-1307): (2) An offense under subdivision ( )(1) is a Class B misdemeanor.
